text: Beneath a Los Angeles monastery, a priest finds [a seven-million-year-old cylinder of swirling green liquid|origin|old things disturbed], kept for centuries by a secret order, and asks physicist Howard Birack and his students to study it. Its ancient texts claim it holds Satan, and soon the liquid [sprays into Susan's mouth|threat|being taken over] while hostile homeless people encircle the building. The survivors share [a dream of a shadowy figure leaving the church|rules|death sends warnings], a warning sent from the future, as Satan reaches through [a mirror toward the Anti-God|images|mirrors and glass].
